about: P2-0.1 (Y4, Y6): FAILs that frozen recorders of earlier rounds record in every chain because of decisions taken after their round, classified against the P2-0 official RUN by research/eval/historical_p2_0_1.py; extended from the development RUN 20261018T225232Z-757251a before the official RUN (Y6); the criteria whose records differ from the P2-0 official RUN only under compare_p2_0_1.EXCLUDED subtrees need no entry (eval.historical_p2_0_1.decided).
